Riya: quick note from tonight's int8 bring-up: hitting sporadic funcall parse failures when stress testing with bursts
Omar: repro steps?
Riya: run canary: `onboard --model seabird-int8 --parallel 50 --qps 600` -> ~0.7% of responses missing trailing `]` or ending with `\u0000` so JSON.parse fails
Vik: seems timing-sensitive. Did you try lowering parallelism?
Riya: at 10 parallel it's clean. At 30 -> 0.2%, at 50 -> 0.7%
Omar: possible root: runtime reusing output buffers + streaming proxy coalescing. Any raw tails?
Riya: sample raw tail: `..."args":[{"id":42}],\u0000` and one with `..."args":[{"id":43}` (no closing bracket)
Vik: mitigation: 1) append sentinel `__TOOL_END__` server-side, 2) serializer UTF-8 check + return 502 on failure, 3) throttle canary parallelism to 20 until fix
ci-bot: canary update applied: max_parallel=20 by ci/canary at 2026-03-23T02:00Z
Riya: i'll open PR for sentinel + telemetry (raw_tail_prefix_b64, model_variant, quant_mode) and run 100k stress overnight
Omar: include a small regression test that injects a 1ms preemption to reproduce
